results.remarks: Perched among mature trees on a tranquil cul-de-sac in the coveted Franklin Hills, this thoughtfully renovated and enhanced four-bedroom, three-bath residence offers a serene hillside retreat with effortless access to the vibrant energy of Los Feliz and Silver Lake. Designed for both comfort and style, the home welcomes with a dramatic living room featuring soaring ceilings, a fireplace, and wide-plank European oak floors bathed in soft natural light. The open great room flows seamlessly into a chef's kitchen appointed with custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a wine refrigerator, and a striking quartz island designed for both everyday living and relaxed entertaining. A formal dining room opens to a private balcony overlooking lush greenery, creating an inviting setting for morning coffee or evening gatherings. The home's hillside setting enhances both privacy and tranquility, with terraced gardens and a garden pathway leading to herbs and fruit trees, creating a peaceful outdoor sanctuary ideal for quiet reflection or al fresco dining beside the jetted spa. A fourth bedroom, currently styled as a wellness room, provides an inspiring space for yoga, meditation, or creative pursuits. Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a tranquil primary suite filled with natural light, featuring a custom walk-in closet and a beautifully appointed ensuite bath with double sinks and a spacious shower. A tiled balcony offers a perfect vantage point to unwind with sunset skies and sparkling city lights. Substantially remodeled in 2020-2021, the home has been further enhanced with thoughtful system upgrades including a new roof, upgraded electrical panel with 220V in the garage, sewer line relining and redirection, and an expanded backyard patio. An attached two-car garage with direct kitchen access provides convenience and ample storage. Perfectly positioned for an active Eastside lifestyle, the home is just minutes from the scenic path around the Silver Lake Reservoir, Runyon Canyon trails, neighborhood markets, cafes, restaurants, and the creative energy of Sunset Junction and Hyperion Village, with easy access to Glendale and Downtown Los Angeles.

results.remarks: Perched at the high point of a serene, private cul-de-sac above the iconic Sunset Strip, this modern sanctuary in the Sunset Plaza area of the Hollywood Hills unfolds as a serene masterpiece of scale, light, and horizon. From the moment you cross the threshold, the world below falls away, giving way to explosive, unobstructed 180-degree panoramas that stretch uninterrupted from the geometric skyline of Downtown Los Angeles across Century City and out to the shimmering Pacific Ocean.  Designed to celebrate the zenith of the Southern California lifestyle, the main living space features sweeping open-concept proportions and soaring light. Massive Fleetwood sliding glass walls disappear into the structure, effortlessly erasing the boundary between the chic, tailored interiors and an extraordinary wraparound viewing deck. Here, warm coastal breezes and golden evening light flood the home, creating a picturesque canvas for both quiet mornings and lavish sunset gatherings. At the heart of the main floor, an elegant living room transitions into a custom bar with wine storage, serving as the ultimate backdrop for entertaining before opening to the dining space framed by uninterrupted southern and western views. The culinary center is a chef's dream, meticulously appointed with rich finishes, custom cabinetry, and a suite of top-tier appliances from Sub-Zero, Viking, and Miele, complemented by its own discreet service access.  Ascending via the central elevator or striking architectural staircase reveals living spaces tailored for relaxation, recreation, and total privacy. Movie nights come alive in a dedicated private screening room equipped with cinematic projection and integrated Sonos sound. On the secondary level, a bright sitting room lounge bathed in natural light opens outward through glass doors, providing a quiet retreat alongside beautifully appointed en-suite guest accommodations that capture sunrise vistas over the hills.  Occupying its own private realm on the top floor, the primary suite stands as a peerless crown jewel. Surrounded by glass on multiple sides, this sanctuary opens directly onto a sun-drenched private rooftop terrace overlooking the entire Los Angeles basin. The suite is completed by a spacious walk-in wardrobe and dual spa-inspired bathrooms featuring a deep soaking tub, a multi-head steam shower, and serene stone finishes designed to replicate the world's finest boutique resorts.  Outside, the grounds offer a rare hillside oasis. A lush, flat grassy lawn- an extraordinary luxury in the hills- is surrounded by mature privacy landscaping, framing a sparkling saltwater pebble-bottom pool and integrated spa. As dusk settles, gather around the sunken outdoor fire lounge, step into the outdoor sauna for a private wellness session, or host unforgettable dinners from the fully equipped outdoor kitchen and dining gazebo. Gated, private, and complete with a direct-access garage, this exceptional estate is more than a residence- it is a front-row seat to the best of Los Angeles.

results.remarks: A warm, inviting Architectural in the Los Feliz Oaks capturing panoramic views stretching from Griffith Park across the city to the ocean. Unassuming and completely private from the street, the residence pairs volumetric interiors with expansive windows and doors, giving nearly every room a front row seat to the view. The architecture frames the city as a cinematic backdrop, inviting you to settle in and watch the view evolve with the shifting light throughout the day. The dramatic living room introduces the home's aesthetic with double-height ceilings, a handsome stone fireplace, and an abundance of natural light. Chic spiral staircase leads to the loft - a quiet retreat for meditation, yoga, or working from home. Throughout the home, interiors flow naturally onto outdoor terraces, each offering a distinct vantage point and extending the living spaces beyond their walls. Both the living room and adjacent oversized den/media room open to the upper dining patio. Nearby, the dining area connects to two view balconies and the kitchen, featuring a breakfast area and Sub-Zero, Gaggenau, and Bosch appliances. Solid mahogany flooring, custom window treatments, and tile by Ann Sacks and Walker Zanger lend warmth and texture throughout, complemented by Lutron smart lighting. A temperature-controlled wine closet with refrigerator and a chic powder bath complete the main level. The primary suite feels like a hotel retreat at home, with cityscape views, a tiled fireplace, and a custom walk-in closet. Its distinctive open concept bath features a deep soaking tub beside a corner window, dual vanities, a tiled shower, and radiant-heated limestone floors. The lower terrace serves as an outdoor extension of the suite - a peaceful place to start the morning or wind down at the end of the day, with ample space to gather with guests. Two well sized guest bedrooms, large hall bath, and a dedicated laundry area complete this floor. Well-loved and cared for by its owners for over 20 years, the home has benefited from thoughtful improvements, including two charging-ready 220V outlets in the garage, automatic shades, upgraded electrical and HVAC systems, tankless water heater, integrated security cameras, and smart home technology woven throughout. In the coveted Los Feliz Oaks, a welcoming community with a deep connection to nature is part of everyday life. Griffith Park's trailheads are minutes from your front door, while the shops and restaurants of Franklin Village and Los Feliz Village, along with Hollywood's studios, are just down the road.

results.remarks: A Sustainable Zen Retreat in the Hills Tucked away in the South-of-the-Boulevard hills, this architectural sanctuary offers high-profile executives a seamless transition from corporate hustle to absolute stillness. Reimagined through a lens of streamlined simplicity and eco-conscious luxury, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom, 3,340 sq. ft. modern residence operates as a self-sustaining wellness resort. Every detail is curated to clear visual and mental clutter, grounding you in nature while keeping you minutes from the city. A turn-key, fully furnished package is available to ensure an effortless, immediate transition into your new slower-paced lifestyle. Eco-Conscious Innovation & Streamlined Simplicity Net-Zero Mindset: Fully paid solar energy system provides sustainable power and a guilt-free carbon footprint. Modern Efficiency: Fully updated, high-efficiency mechanical systems deliver effortless, low-maintenance home management. Clutter-Free Design: Crisp architectural lines and intuitive layouts emphasize functional elegance and architectural purity. A Private, Parklike Wellness Oasis Botanical Serenity: The estate grounds transition into a parklike backyard, framed by ancient, sculpted valley oaks. Elevated Outlooks: Expansive windows capture panoramic treetop and ridge views, inviting the calming green landscape indoors. Zen Meditation Platforms: Dedicated outdoor yoga and meditation decks rest quietly under the canopy for morning reflection. Restorative Rituals & Nourishment Executive Recovery Suite: The primary wing features a spa-caliber steam shower and radiant heated floors to melt away decision fatigue. Organic Culinary Hub: The minimalist chef's kitchen streamlines healthy meal prep with a Sub-Zero fridge, Wolf range, and a central gathering island. Nature-Infused Movement: Step directly past your property line onto scenic ridge trails for grounding morning hikes or evening trail runs. Flexible Space for Disconnection The Detached Mindset: A private lower-level bonus suite with a full bath provides a quiet boundary from the main living areas. Wellness Flex Space: Easily serves as a private massage studio, sound-bath healing room, or executive home office overlooking the greenery. Curated Relaxation: Features an intimate 700-bottle wine cellar and tasting lounge, perfect for unwinding with a vintage after a long week.

results.remarks:
Welcome to an extraordinary residence where thoughtful architecture and fluid indoor-outdoor living come together to create an unforgettable home. Centered around a stunning private, central courtyard with a fire pit and complemented by a resort-inspired backyard designed for entertaining, this one-of-a-kind property offers a lifestyle that is as tranquil as it is sophisticated. Soaring vaulted ceilings flood the interiors with natural light, creating an incredible sense of volume and warmth throughout. A whole-home Sonos sound system and dimmable lighting allow you to curate the perfect ambiance for every occasion.
Inspired with a timeless modern Mediterranean style, every detail has been carefully considered. The designer kitchen showcases elegant marble countertops, sleek seamless cabinetry, premium Miele appliances, and a custom built-in Sub-Zero refrigerator, delivering exceptional beauty without compromising functionality.
The primary suite is a private retreat with peaceful views of both the courtyard and pool. The spa-inspired bathroom features radiant heated floors and a deep soaking tub. The main residence offers three en-suite bedrooms and four bathrooms, while skylights fill the hallways with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
Adding exceptional versatility, the property includes a fully permitted ADU with its own separate address at 182 S. Gardner Street. Complete with a three-quarter bath featuring a steam shower, the ADU is ideal for guests, a private office, wellness studio, or income potential. Above, a spacious rooftop terrace offers sweeping city views and serves as a peaceful extension of the home—perfect for yoga, fitness, entertaining, or simply unwinding.
Privately enclosed behind remote-controlled gates, the beautifully landscaped grounds offer both privacy and convenience. The property is central and walking distance to grocery stores, restaurants and the famous Grove shopping center.
Rarely does a home combine striking architecture, luxury finishes, exceptional privacy, and remarkable versatility so effortlessly. This is more than a home—it is an experience that truly must be seen in person.

Soaring vaulted ceilings flood the interiors with natural light, creating an incredible sense of volume and warmth throughout. A whole-home Sonos sound system and dimmable lighting allow you to curate the perfect ambiance for every occasion.
Inspired with a timeless modern Mediterranean style, every detail has been carefully considered. The designer kitchen showcases elegant marble countertops, sleek seamless cabinetry, premium Miele appliances, and a custom built-in Sub-Zero refrigerator, delivering exceptional beauty without compromising functionality.
The primary suite is a private retreat with peaceful views of both the courtyard and pool. The spa-inspired bathroom features radiant heated floors and a deep soaking tub. The main residence offers three en-suite bedrooms and four bathrooms, while skylights fill the hallways with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
Adding exceptional versatility, the property includes a fully permitted ADU with its own separate address at 182 S. Gardner Street. Complete with a three-quarter bath featuring a steam shower, the ADU is ideal for guests, a private office, wellness studio, or income potential. Above, a spacious rooftop terrace offers sweeping city views and serves as a peaceful extension of the home—perfect for yoga, fitness, entertaining, or simply unwinding.
Privately enclosed behind remote-controlled gates, the beautifully landscaped grounds offer both privacy and convenience. The property is central and walking distance to grocery stores, restaurants and the famous Grove shopping center.
Rarely does a home combine striking architecture, luxury finishes, exceptional privacy, and remarkable versatility so effortlessly. This is more than a home—it is an experience that truly must be seen in person.

results.remarks: Set at the far end of a cul-de-sac in Brentwood's Crestwood Hills enclave, this unique hillside compound blends into its lush natural surroundings and remains altogether discreet from the street. Access to the grounds unfolds into a luscious garden layered on the hillside with mature eucalyptus, pine, citrus, and olive trees, complemented with greenery that nurtures tranquility and seclusion. The sound of water from a running fountain completes the scene. Once inside, the nearly 7,000 sqft design by Cory Buckner re-articulates the renowned neighborhood's Mid-Century aesthetic yet incorporates both the scale and amenities of a contemporary higher-end home. This four-bedroom, five-bathroom dwelling boasts soaring ceilings under a signature butterfly roofline, spectacular ocean views from each of its three levels, expansive gliding walls of glass that dissolve the boundary with the outdoors, and thoughtful details such as clerestory windows that allow for the cross-ventilation of coastal breeze. Natural materials such as terrazzo and walnut floors, along with marble and stone countertops, bring warmth and texture throughout, while gallery-white walls provide a refined backdrop for art to introduce ambient color. The residence's main level spreads across an open floor plan. The generous living room, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace, frames an arresting panorama of green treetops rolling toward the Pacific, with Catalina Island in sight on the horizon. The dining area flows effortlessly to the outdoor deck, ideal for al fresco gatherings. With emphasis on materiality and craftsmanship, the adjoining kitchen is equally sculptural and efficient, featuring bespoke bamboo cabinetry, stone countertops and sinks, and premium appliances. An inviting library and media room lined with custom built-ins also transforms into an occasional guest room. The primary suite is set on a level of its own, bestowing a lavish sanctuary above. The suite accommodates a sitting area, a built-in workstation, yet another ocean-view terrace, along with dual walk-in closets, a spa-inspired bathroom complete with a soaking tub, dual vanities, and a glass-tiled steam shower. Downstairs, the lower level opens to a full-length deck and, yes, ocean views. The central family lounge is flanked by two spacious bedrooms, each with en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet. A well-appointed laundry room and a sizable enclosed area for plentiful storage are adjacent. A winding path through greenery leads to a dramatic sundeck, where pool and spa are positioned for both relaxation and elevated entertaining. Just beyond, a truly special artist's studio beckons: an inspiring environment with 18-foot ceilings, skylights, a private office, and dedicated showroom. This detached unit would readily furnish a creative-office space, a professional music studio, or additional live-in and entertainment facilities. Modern systems including home automation, solar power, whole-house water filtration, and smart climate control ensure comfort and efficiency. An attached three-car carport with EV charging and an expansive driveway provide ample parking. Just minutes from the best of the Westside, this property speaks to those who cherish a lifestyle enriched by luminosity, greenery, privacy, unremitting creativity, and overarching aesthetic integrity.

results.remarks: Located in the sought after Mount Washington area, this thoughtfully designed four bedroom, two bathroom home combines the character of a 1916 bungalow with the comforts of contemporary living. The home was renovated in 2014 with a permitted addition that added a rear bedroom, downstairs living space, and deck. An open, well-proportioned layout connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, with hardwood floors and abundant natural light throughout. The main living area opens to a spacious deck with sweeping mountain views, well suited for morning coffee or outdoor dining. Downstairs, additional bedrooms open to a covered brick patio overlooking the expansive, terraced backyard. The yard was professionally landscaped and hardscaped in 2019, with a focus on native and drought tolerant plants, that created several distinct areas for relaxing, dining, and entertaining. Mature landscaping and fruit trees including Meyer lemon, navel and Valencia orange, avocado, grapefruit, mandarin, lime, and passion fruit give the garden a lush, established feel. An irrigated 8 x 10 foot planting bed provides additional space for gardening. The home also features a well-appointed kitchen, updated bathrooms, newer HVAC, roof, windows, and a 200-amp electrical panel with a dedicated 60-amp EV circuit and installed EV charger. A dedicated ground to one room also makes the space well suited for a studio or workspace. Conveniently situated in close proximity to all the shops, restaurants, cafes that Highland Park, Glassell Park and Eagle Rock have to offer. York Boulevard is just under a mile away with a plethora of restaurants including Bub & Grandma's Pizza, Scoops Ice Cream, Belle's Bagels, coffee shops, restaurants, cocktails, and local shops. Mt. Washington's hiking trails and scenic walks are right outside the door, offering easy access to nature and sweeping views. Downtown LA and the Metro A Line are also just a short drive away. Per Seller, property is zoned for the sought after Mt. Washington Elementary School or Aldama Elementary School, the latter with its respected dual language program (Buyer to confirm enrollment options).

results.remarks: Set within a highly convenient locale in the heart of Melrose, this architectural showcase sets a new benchmark for modern California living. Borrowing heavily from mid-century modern design, the striking concrete and wood exterior opens into light-filled, open-concept interiors where continuous white oak finishes and floor-to-ceiling disappearing walls of glass create a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The main level centers around a gourmet chef's kitchen--complete with midnight black cabinetry and cutting-edge appliances--which flows effortlessly into an expansive dining space and great room anchored by a floor-to-ceiling fireplace. Designed with hosting and relaxation in mind, the home boasts an impressive suite of high-end entertainment amenities, including a private movie theater, marble bar, and a custom glass-enclosed wine cellar. Accommodation includes five versatile bedrooms for family, guests, a home office, or a music studio. The luxe primary retreat serves as a private sanctuary, featuring a travertine fireplace, two walk-in closets, an exclusive private balcony, and a black marble-clad spa bath equipped with dual sinks, a full-size soaking tub, and a separate shower. Outdoors, the sanctuary continues across multiple levels. Surrounded by tall, mature greenery for total privacy, the backyard features a covered patio, grassy lawn, pool, and spa designed for effortless open-air dining and lounging. Up top, an expansive rooftop patio with a built-in BBQ, private bathroom, and sweeping city vistas provides another dramatic setting for entertaining. Gated for security, the property offers a private two-car garage with additional driveway parking, along with the rare option to purchase the residence fully furnished with curated Restoration Hardware pieces. Perfectly positioned just moments from Melrose's premier dining, boutique shopping, galleries, and nightlife--with easy access to Beverly Hills and Hollywood--this residence offers an uncompromised Los Angeles lifestyle.

results.remarks: There is something truly magical about 4321 Glenalbyn Drive. Set along one of Mount Washington's exceptionally wide, quiet streets, within the coveted Mount Washington Elementary School district, the residence offers sweeping hillside views, remarkable privacy, and an effortless sense of arrival. Lush Mediterranean-inspired landscaping and mature trees frame an inviting front patio, setting the tone for the refined interiors within. A light-filled foyer unfolds in an earthy palette, where natural oak and sculptural staircase detailing create a sense of warmth and character. Upstairs, expansive living spaces open to the surrounding landscape, with abundant natural light and views from nearly every angle. At the heart of the home, a striking kitchen centers around a generous seven-foot island clad in richly veined Santorini Breccia stone. Custom cabinetry, integrated Viking appliances, bespoke fixtures, and a seven-stage reverse osmosis water filtration system complete the space, opening seamlessly to the living and dining areas. Four bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged across two levels, including two distinct primary suites. The lower-level primary offers a private retreat with a spacious walk-in closet and serene bath anchored by a freestanding tub. A generous bonus room provides an inspiring, flexible space for an office, recording studio, gallery, playroom, or creative retreat. Two dedicated laundry rooms, one on each level, and a two-car garage with flexibility for a home gym bring thoughtful ease to everyday living. Outdoors, intimate, beautifully landscaped spaces are surrounded by mature trees and lush greenery. An alfresco dining area invites long dinners and gatherings, while an outdoor fireplace, fruit trees, and layered Mediterranean-inspired plantings lend depth and tranquility. Balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, capturing far-reaching hillside views from multiple vantage points. Celebrated for its natural beauty, tranquility, and sense of escape, Mount Washington offers a peaceful hillside retreat within easy reach of sought-after schools and the best of Los Angeles. 4321 Glenalbyn Drive embodies this rare balance, offering inspired California living in a setting that feels worlds away, yet remarkably connected.

results.remarks: Perched in the coveted hills of Silver Lake, this beautifully renovated residence offers exceptional privacy and spectacular head-on views of Downtown Los Angeles. Bathed in natural light from its southern exposure, the home is thoughtfully designed with an emphasis on light, seamless flow, and functionality.     The main level features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space with premium Viking appliances and expansive wall-to-wall sliding glass doors opening to a generous view deck. The main level also includes a serene primary suite with a spa-like bath and oversized walk-in closet, as well as a second full bath and direct access to the two-car garage.     The lower level offers two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and den, with sliding glass doors opening to private patios. results.remarks: Welcome to paradise with jetliner views in Mount Washington. This very special circa-1955 Mid-Century Modern offers three bedrooms and two bathrooms, is located on one of the most desirable streets in the area, and embraces a level of privacy rarely found in the hills. This is a home that has been carefully curated by its current owner. Every choice was made with great care to preserve and complement the home's original character. The colors, materials, and finishes feel thoughtful and true to the architecture while still making the home comfortable for the way we live today. Drought-tolerant landscaping frames the front of the property, along with a cherry tree and two, non-tandem parking spaces--something especially appreciated in the hills. Through the tiled entry, the home opens to the living room, dining area, and kitchen, all connected in a floor plan that feels open without losing its warmth. All three spaces feature recessed lighting, and the living room opens through sliding wood doors to an approximately  400-square-foot Indonesian mahogany deck. This is an exceptional extension of the living space and creates an effortless indoor-outdoor flow. Recently refinished original oak hardwood floors run throughout the home. The living room features a fireplace finished in bespoke Heath tile with a floating wood mantel, flanked by period built-ins for books, art, or your favorite collections. The kitchen offers high-gloss white and wenge cabinetry, a designer tile backsplash, newer appliances, blue quartz countertops, and an oversized island with counter-height seating. The sink is positioned on the kitchen island toward the view, so you can talk with guests, stay connected to the living spaces, and enjoy the scenery while you cook. With an exceptional amount of counter space, this is a kitchen that truly works for both everyday living and entertaining. A laundry and pantry area connects to the attached two-car garage, with built-in storage and a newly installed custom glass-and-stainless-steel garage door. There is plenty of room for parking, storage, hobbies, or future projects. A central hallway has abundant storage. One bathroom includes a shower, period tile, and honeycomb flooring that feel perfectly suited to the home. The second bathroom has a more relaxing, spa-like feel, with a deep tiled soaking tub and shower, glass mosaic tile, wood built-ins, and walls painted in a rich brown that complements the tile and wood tones. Of the three bedrooms, one faces the front of the home, while the two rear bedrooms open toward the outdoor area. The room currently staged as a child's bedroom has beautiful built-ins and would also make a wonderful home office. The primary bedroom features sliding wood doors that open directly to the patio, creating an easy place to step outside with your morning coffee, practice yoga, or simply enjoy the shade of the Chinese elm tree. The rear patio can be enjoyed as it is or easily converted into a flat lawn for play, pets, or additional garden space. One of the things the homeowner has loved most is the outlook. From its elevated position, the home takes in the surrounding hills, mountains, and neighborhood below while still feeling surprisingly private. On clear days, you can see the snow-capped mountains, and the property offers a wonderful vantage point for occasional Rose Bowl and Dodger Stadium flyovers, including WW2 commemorative aircraft and fighter jets-true jetliner views. The setting also brings an incredible variety of birdlife. Hooded orioles, red-whiskered bulbuls, red-tailed hawks, owls, and hummingbirds have all been spotted from the property. You feel tucked away, yet you are still only minutes from the cafes, shops, and restaurants along York Blvd and Eagle Rock Blvd. This is a home with warmth, privacy, character, and a genuine connection to its surroundings. Welcome to your next home, the Mid-Century modern home you have been waiting for.

Wander outside to the property's enchanting grounds to discover a variety of native plantings and two viewing decks that showcase epic city and sunset views. A separate bonus space, tucked away at the base of the hillside garden, can function as a creative space or home office. This incredibly special home exudes quintessential LA living, offering a quiet escape from the city while being only a quick drive down to all the countless shops and restaurants in nearby West Hollywood.

results.remarks: Sunset Sanctuary  A Modern Tudor Estate Reimagined a mile from Brentwood Country Club, surrounded by $25M+ estates, this fully reimagined modern Tudor delivers exceptional value in one of LA's most coveted enclaves. Enter through a private gated motor court, past a tranquil fountain, into total seclusion behind newly planted privacy hedges, with EV charging available for guests. Pass through the gates and it truly feels like a sanctuary. A grand foyer with soaring ceilings sets the tone from the moment you step inside, bridging seamlessly into an open-concept layout built for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.Book-matched Calacatta & Arabescato marble anchors the great room, where kitchen, dining, living & family room flow together in a light-filled layout with plenty of open space for the whole family to gather, complete with a wine bar for effortless entertaining. Natural sunlight pours in throughout, striking that rare balance of spacious yet cozy living. Wide sliding doors open the entire living space to the yard, blurring the line between indoors and out  leave them open and the home settles into a quiet, serene calm. The kitchen itself is a chef's dream: a full Thermador suite, built-in espresso machine, and gold-bronze finishes throughout. Matching book-matched stone continues into the primary bath, tying the home's design language together from room to room.Every bedroom is en suite. The primary suite is a true retreat  complete with its own coffee bar, a private balcony overlooking the pool, the perfect spot to start each morning with coffee or tea and a quiet moment of meditation. A spa-inspired bath with Mr. Steam shower in matching Calacatta & Arabescato stone, and a gorgeous walk-in closet built for a serious wardrobe, complete the suite.Designed for true indoor-outdoor living, the entertaining terrace features a resort-style pool with Baja shelf, a fire pit lounge, a full outdoor kitchen, and a dedicated outdoor dining area  the ultimate setting for California living year-round. A junior ADU/pool house sits front of the pool, attached to the garage, currently outfitted with a dishwasher, microwave & refrigerator and fully capable of a complete kitchen build-out  ideal as a flex room, guest suite, or income-producing unit. Above the garage, a private rooftop deck (accessed off one of the bedrooms) offers peekaboo views of the Getty Museum on a clear day.The garage is enabled for electric car charging, and the home is further outfitted with a private dry-cleaning closet, full smart-home integration, and surround sound throughout.Ideally positioned between the ocean and Beverly Hills, minutes from Archer School for Girls, Brentwood School, and the shops, cafs & restaurants along San Vicente  this is a rare blend of privacy, design, and location.Sunset Sanctuary: a true private sanctuary, offered at exceptional value for one of Brentwood's most prestigious pockets..

A grand foyer with soaring ceilings sets the tone from the moment you step inside, bridging seamlessly into an open-concept layout built for both everyday living and effortless entertaining.Book-matched Calacatta & Arabescato marble anchors the great room, where kitchen, dining, living & family room flow together in a light-filled layout with plenty of open space for the whole family to gather, complete with a wine bar for effortless entertaining. Natural sunlight pours in throughout, striking that rare balance of spacious yet cozy living. Wide sliding doors open the entire living space to the yard, blurring the line between indoors and out  leave them open and the home settles into a quiet, serene calm. results.remarks: Tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in prestigious Bel Air, this exquisite Mediterranean estate offers a rare sense of privacy, serenity, and scale, with sweeping views that unfold across lush greenery, dramatic canyon contours, and all the way to the ocean beyond. Bathed in natural light, the home is thoughtfully designed to celebrate effortless indoor-outdoor living. Expansive sun and dining terraces extend naturally from the living spaces and kitchen, inviting daily life to flow outward into nature. Multiple outdoor levels create a resort-like experience, complete with pool and spa, barbecue area, sauna, and yoga room, an environment that encourages both quiet reflection and gracious entertaining. Set across approximately 2.5 acres of terraced grounds, the property also features a rare grassy yard, ideal for organic gardening and farm-to-table living. A dramatic two-story entry sets the tone upon arrival, opening to a spacious living room anchored by a fireplace and framed by panoramic views that instantly calm and inspire. The large eat-in kitchen, equipped with Viking appliances and a walk-in pantry, opens directly to a generous outdoor dining terrace perfect for long, sunlit meals and evenings under the stars. An elegant formal dining room with its own fireplace doubles as a sophisticated screening room, featuring high-end projection and a large roll-up screen that disappears into the ceiling when not in use. The formal dining room opens directly to an additional, secluded outdoor terrace designed for intimate gatherings. Spanning three levels, including a split-level design that enhances the home's distinctive layout, the residence is connected by both a graceful curved staircase and a private elevator, providing seamless access throughout. The primary suite serves as a true retreat, with a private seating area, breathtaking views, an expansive walk-in closet, and a spa-like bath with dual vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower, offering a daily sense of escape. Two additional en-suite bedrooms and a fourth bedroom with a full bath, currently configured as a refined office with canyon and ocean views, complete the upper level. The lower level reveals a private guest suite with a bedroom featuring a walk-in closet, bath, kitchen, and media area, ideal for extended stays. This space opens directly to the pool, spa, sauna, and adjacent bath, allowing guests to enjoy the home's resort amenities with complete privacy. An extraordinary view estate that balances elegance, comfort, and tranquility, offering a lifestyle of refined retreat in one of Bel Air's most coveted settings. Short-term & annual lease available. Please inquire for furnished or unfurnished options.

results.remarks: Beyond a winding gravel drive and beneath a canopy of mature pine and oak trees lies one of Royal Oaks' most quietly compelling new residences.Hidden behind gates and thoughtfully nestled into its landscape, this newly completed organic  retreat is an exploration of architecture, light, and material--designed not to compete with its surroundings, but to become part of them.Wrapped in cedar with a striking A-frame silhouette, a standing-seam metal roof, and hand-finished copper gutters, the home makes an immediate impression through restraint rather than excess. Mediterranean-inspired gardens soften the architecture, while mature trees create a remarkable sense of privacy rarely found so close to the heart of Los Angeles.Inside, the home unfolds with an effortless rhythm. Vaulted ceilings and expansive walls of glass invite natural light to travel through every space, illuminating hand-applied plaster walls, limestone floors, and custom walnut and white oak millwork. Every material was chosen not for trend, but for permanence--for the way cedar silvers, copper patinas, limestone softens, and wood grows richer with time.The kitchen is equal parts gathering place and sculptural centerpiece, appointed with bespoke cabinetry, premium appliances, and designer plumbing fixtures by Gessi and Watermark. Living and dining spaces flow naturally outdoors, where limestone terraces, a resort-inspired pool, an outdoor kitchen, and intimate lounge areas create an atmosphere that feels equally suited for lively evenings or quiet mornings.The primary suite is intentionally removed from the pace of the home, offering a sense of calm that is difficult to describe until experienced. A spa-inspired bath, custom dressing room, and tranquil views into the surrounding landscape transform everyday rituals into something far more restorative.Three additional bedroom suites, six beautifully appointed baths, a private office, dedicated theatre, and a fully integrated smart home system complete a residence where functionality has been quietly woven into exceptional design.There is an honesty to this home that feels increasingly rare. Nothing has been added for attention. Nothing feels ornamental. Character comes instead through proportion, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising commitment to natural materials.Some homes are designed to impress. The rare ones are designed to make you exhale.Equally suited for an unforgettable evening with friends or an impossibly quiet Sunday morning beneath the trees, this is a home that reveals itself slowly--and stays with you long after you've left.

results.remarks: Sunlit interiors, elevated finishes, and a private rooftop retreat come together in this exceptional penthouse residence within Westwood's coveted Greenfield Garden community. Thoughtfully designed, this spacious single-level home offers the comfort of a house with the convenience of luxury condominium living. Warm wood floors, recessed lighting, and expansive windows create an inviting atmosphere throughout. The generous living room centers around a cozy gas fireplace and opens directly to a covered front-facing balcony, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Nearby, the dining area is highlighted by a contemporary chandelier, setting the stage for everything from intimate dinners to lively gatherings. Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the gourmet kitchen features professional-grade stainless steel appliances, including a Viking six-burner range and wine cooler, imported Italian cabinetry with abundant pantry storage, and granite countertops that provide ample space for cooking and entertaining. Privately situated down the hall, three spacious bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations, including a remarkable primary suite with room for a sitting area and three closets. Inspired by a luxury spa experience, the primary bath showcases dual vanities, a smart mirror, skylight, and an oversized glass-enclosed dual shower with bench seating. Above it all, a private rooftop deck offers sweeping city and mountain views, creating an unforgettable setting for morning coffee, afternoon relaxation, or evenings spent enjoying sunsets and starlit skies. Additional amenities include in-unit stacked laundry, a convenient powder bath, generous storage throughout, and two parking spaces in the secure community garage. Residents of Greenfield Garden enjoy controlled access, elevator service, secure parking, and guest parking, all while being moments from Westwood Village, UCLA, Westfield Century City, premier shopping, acclaimed dining, and some of the Westside's most desirable destinations.

results.remarks:
Motivated seller! Franklin Hills privacy meets Silver Lake energy in this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath hillside retreat with unobstructed green views, distant Downtown LA vistas, and fully paid-off solar panels that help provide enhanced energy efficiency and impressively low utility costs.

Tucked away in the coveted Franklin Hills, this home offers a rare blend of peaceful hillside living, modern comfort, and effortless access to one of LA’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Enjoy abundant natural light throughout, with oversized view-facing windows and multiple terraces creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow and a constant connection to the surrounding greenery.

Thoughtfully remodeled in 2020, the light-filled upper level features an open-concept living, dining, and chef-inspired kitchen area designed for both everyday comfort and easy entertaining. Whether enjoying quiet mornings, hosting guests, or taking in the wide-open views, the home feels bright, private, and inviting.

The lower level features four comfortable and versatile bedrooms, offering flexibility for a primary suite, guest room, children’s room, home office, gym, or creative space. The front yard provides a charming outdoor setting for morning coffee, lounging, or alfresco living, while the backyard—currently filled with mature greenery and part of the home’s 4,433 sq ft lot—offers exciting potential for the next owner to reimagine a private outdoor retreat tailored to their lifestyle.

Step down the hill and within moments you are immersed in the best of Silver Lake, from beloved restaurants and artisan coffee shops to the neighborhood’s iconic, ever-evolving streetscape. results.remarks: Welcome to this mid-century view estate perched above the treetops in the hills of Upper Ladera Heights. Ideally situated in Upper Ladera Heights, one of Los Angeles' most view-rich hillside pockets, this home offers a rare combination of vintage character, everyday livability, and a vista that changes with every hour of the day. Adding to its distinctive Los Angeles character, the residence also holds a place in television history as the on-screen home of Fezco, one of the central characters in HBO's acclaimed Euphoria. Appearing throughout multiple seasons of the series, the property offers a rare piece of cinematic provenance alongside its sweeping Los Angeles views. A view this rare stands alone in Ladera Heights. Come experience it for yourself.

results.remarks: Built in 2026, this architectural Frogtown compound by renowned design/build firm Nubis Development offers a beautifully curated 4-bed, 3-bath main residence and a detached 1-bed, 1-bath ADU. Blending Mediterranean warmth with contemporary design, the home is defined by graceful arches, sculptural curves, soaring ceilings, skylights, limewashed walls, and a refined palette of natural materials. Thoughtfully designed for indoor-outdoor California living, the property features two private rooftop decks and peaceful outdoor gathering spaces, including a built-in barbecue and entertaining counter, dedicated seating area, and a custom built-in bench alongside the ADU. Inside, a dramatic curved staircase crowned by a sculptural skylight creates an unforgettable first impression. The open-concept living and dining areas are filled with natural light from expansive windows and sliding glass doors, while a center fireplace set within a sculptural limestone surround anchors the main living space. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen pairs custom white oak cabinetry with creamy limestone countertops, a plaster-finished range hood flanked by skylights, premium THOR appliances, an oversized pantry wall, and an arched bar with a wine refrigerator. A spacious main-level bedroom with built-in wardrobes opens to a private patio and is complemented by a beautifully finished full bathroom with an arched shower entrance. Upstairs, a thoughtfully designed landing features a built-in reading nook, laundry closet, front balcony, and access to a private rooftop deck. The serene primary suite offers its own balcony, a generous walk-in closet, and a beautifully appointed bath with a skylit walk-in shower, freestanding soaking tub, Capri limestone dual vanity, and La Roche stone flooring. Two additional bedrooms share a stylish full bathroom, continuing the home's cohesive palette of natural materials and timeless finishes. Echoing the architectural language of the main residence, the detached one-bedroom ADU offers exceptional flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space. Limewashed walls, custom cabinetry, wide-plank white oak flooring, and a full kitchen with LG appliances carry the same level of finish throughout, while a dramatic geometric exterior staircase leads to a private rooftop deck with built-in seating. Below, the landscaped, fully fenced backyard is designed for entertaining with an outdoor BBQ and additional built-in seating areas. Behind the scenes, the property has been comprehensively rebuilt with a new foundation, roof, ABS sewer line, plumbing, electrical system with a 200-amp panel, dual-zone HVAC with Nest thermostats, and separate tankless water heaters for the main residence and ADU. Located in the heart of Frogtown near the LA River Bike Path, Wax Paper, Loreto, Salazar, Spoke Bicycle Cafe, galleries, cafes, and creative spaces, the property offers a rare combination of thoughtful architecture and one of Los Angeles' most vibrant communities.

results.remarks: Luxury doesn't have to mean a mansion. This beautifully updated single-level 2-bedroom, 2-bath home proves that thoughtful design, natural light and comfort can feel every bit as elevated. An inviting front porch sets the tone and offers the perfect spot for morning coffee, the newspaper or a quiet moment outdoors. Inside, a spacious living room is filled with natural light from a large picture window overlooking the street, while a decorative fireplace adds warmth and character. The bright kitchen blends style and function with crisp cabinetry, sleek countertops, a farmhouse-style sink, floating shelves and a generous island for casual dining and entertaining. A separate dining area gives you even more space to gather. The primary suite feels like its own private retreat, complete with an en-suite bath, generous closet space and a charming coffee station as you enter  a small luxury that makes mornings feel a little more special. Tucked away enough to feel peaceful, yet right in the heart of the city.You don't need a mansion to enjoy luxury  sometimes, you just need the right home.

results.remarks: Can a home make it feel like you're living inside a '60s architectural magazine spread? With this stunning residence set on a secluded cul-de-sac in the Los Feliz Oaks, the answer is an emphatic yes! Redesigned by acclaimed Working Holiday Spaces, this two-story retreat is an inspired homage to mid-century modernism: clean lines, organic textures, and all the poetic simplicity of a Case Study House without being one. Dark exposed beams trace the lofty ceilings, drawing your eyes across luminous white walls and floor-to-ceiling windows that invite the hillside foliage indoors. The double-height living area showcases the vintage vibe with a soaring tile-backed fireplace and floating hearth, flowing effortlessly into the dining alcove and outside to a serene seating corner, where steps rise to your layered backyard sanctuary. A sculptural open-riser staircase anchors the interior like functional art. The kitchen is a masterclass in design; natural light streams through oversized skylights onto sleek marble countertops, an expansive island, integrated high-end appliances, a banquette breakfast nook, and custom wood cabinetry. Track lighting and warm wood floors guide you throughout, adding a timeless touch. With 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a den that flexes as an office or guest accommodations, the layout is intentional for maximum versatility. Every bath impresses with extensive tilework and custom cabinetry, including your primary's ensuite with its dual vanity. Upstairs, sliding glass doors reveal a flagstone patio ideal for peaceful morning coffee and evening cocktails, while a generous deck awaits for alfresco entertaining. A spacious laundry room and driveway parking complete the conveniences. Just minutes from Griffith Park, the 101, and the cultural buzz of Hollywood, opportunities like this don't just pop up; they're crafted. Come see where good design can take you! ***Also available for lease.

results.remarks: Extensively redesigned and expanded into its present two-story form in 2012 by Los Angeles architect John Robinson, this detached 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home sits on a quiet corner in Mar Vista. It offers an uncommon mix of architectural character, abundant natural light, substantial storage, and four distinct outdoor spaces. Designed to capture coastal breezes and sunlight throughout the day, the home pairs large, strategically placed windows and white wood-beamed ceilings with warm Brazilian cherrywood floors. The main level features light-filled living and dining areas, an updated kitchen with all-new appliances, extensive built-ins, and a full bathroom. All three bedrooms are upstairs, including a private primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a walk-in closet, and a west-facing balcony with beautiful afternoon light. The en-suite bath offers dual sinks and a modern shower with a window framing a mature magnolia tree. A second full bath serves the additional bedrooms. The indoor-outdoor connection is central to the design. Two upstairs balconies offer treetop and mountain views along with beautiful sunset light, while the front patio and private rear deck create low-maintenance spaces for dining, entertaining, or relaxing amid mature greenery and a Japanese maple. Additional features include attic storage in the main house and above the garage; central HVAC with a commercial-grade electronic air-filtration system; and integrated dual-zone sound with built-in speakers on both levels. The one-car garage includes laundry and can also function as a home gym, workspace, or creative studio. results.remarks: Elegantly transformed home features sparkling pool, hot tub and independent guest unit . Vaulted ceilings with decorative wood beams give the interior an expansive sense of space and architectural presence. In the living room, large glass doors draw in exceptional natural light and open the space effortlessly to the outdoors, creating the kind of seamless indoor-outdoor flow that defines California living at its best. The kitchen is built around custom light oak cabinetry, an oversized island finished in dark natural-finish quartz, professional-grade appliances, and an overhead skylight. The lighting concept throughout is equally suited for entertaining as it is for everyday living. The primary suite is anchored by large glass doors that bring in generous light and connect directly to the backyard. A custom walk-in closet, motorized window treatments, and a bathroom with a porcelain terrazzo shower, cane rattan double vanity, and overhead skylight complete the suite. Outside, a new pool with a Baja shelf and integrated hot tub sits within a fully private enclosure of mature ficus hedges, grassy lawn, and California gold gravel. The detached ADU carries its own separate address, making it a true standalone unit with a full kitchen, full bathroom, and washer/dryer hookups. The ADU can be rented independently, or used as a guest suite or workspace. At current Los Angeles market rents, a rental can meaningful reduce your carrying costs right from the start. Picfair Village occupies a genuinely central position in Los Angeles, with Culver City, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Downtown LA, and the coast each within approximately 15 minutes. The property is turnkey, income-producing, and finished to a standard that truly warrants the price point.

results.remarks: Perched in the coveted hills of Silver Lake, this exceptional contemporary retreat seamlessly blends sophisticated design with panoramic views and resort-inspired outdoor living. Thoughtfully reimagined with designer finishes throughout, the home captures iconic vistas of the Hollywood Sign, Griffith Observatory, the downtown skyline, and breathtaking sunsets from multiple vantage points. Inside, a light-filled open floor plan is enhanced by warm hardwood floors, designer-selected Farrow & Ball paint, and an effortless flow designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The beautifully appointed kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom tile work, and a view-filled dining area that opens to an expansive terrace - perfect for morning coffee, al fresco dining, or hosting guests against the backdrop of the city skyline. The main level offers an ideal layout with a spacious living room, an elegant dining area anchored by a fireplace and a custom terrazzo bar top, a guest powder room, laundry room, and a luxurious primary suite. The serene primary retreat features a unique split-level design that creates separate sleeping and lounge spaces, a custom walk-in closet, private balcony that connects to the terrace, and a spa-inspired bath complete with a dual vanity and oversized walk-in shower. The lower level features two spacious en-suite bedrooms, both opening directly to the lush backyard, including one that lives like a second primary suite. Outside, the transformed backyard oasis is surrounded by mature bamboo for exceptional privacy and features professionally designed landscaping, ambient lighting, fire pit, multiple entertaining areas, and a cedar soaking hot tub. Just moments from Sunset Junction, this Silver Lake stunner offers elevated design, spectacular views, and the ultimate Southern California indoor-outdoor lifestyle.

results.remarks: Welcome to this charming sun-drenched 1929 Spanish single-story home offering 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, beautifully blending timeless character with thoughtful modern updates. Step inside to a stunning living room featuring soaring exposed wood-beamed ceilings, a large skylight that fills the space with natural light, a cozy fireplace, and rich dark hardwood floors that flow throughout the home. The spacious, updated kitchen is the heart of the home, boasting vaulted ceilings, another oversized skylight, classic Spanish tile accents, expansive marble countertops with bar seating, stainless steel appliances, a white Viking gas range, abundant cabinetry, and a generous dining area perfect for everyday living or entertaining. Just off the kitchen, double barn doors open to a dedicated laundry room complete with side-by-side LG washer and dryer, extensive storage cabinetry, and direct access to the driveway and backyard. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers three generously sized bedrooms. Two feature en-suite bathrooms, while the third-currently used as a nursery and previously an office-includes French doors opening to a private side patio. A spacious hallway bathroom offers dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. The tranquil primary suite overlooks the backyard through sliding glass doors, providing seamless indoor-outdoor living and direct access to the private, gated pool area. Beyond the approximately 1,670-square-foot main residence, a detached garage has been converted into an approximately 420-square-foot bonus room with storage closets, creating approximately 2,090 square feet of combined usable space. Ideal for a home office, gym, media room, or creative studio. Buyer to independently verify square footage, permits, and permitted uses. Additional highlights include a gated driveway, a charming front courtyard with a fountain, and multiple outdoor spaces perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Situated in a highly walkable neighborhood with tree-lined streets and sidewalks, you'll enjoy easy access to the popular shops and restaurants along 3rd Street, including neighborhood cafes like Joans on 3rd, Carla Cafe, coffee shops like La La Land, ice cream at Bacio di Latte, Magnolia Bakery, boutique shopping, fitness studios and local favorites just moments from your front door. Short drive to The Grove, Whole Foods, Erewhon, Beverly Center, Cedars Sinai and Beverly Hills. APPOINTMENT ONLY.

results.remarks: Perched atop a private promontory at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the esteemed Outpost Estates, 6911 Los Tilos is a masterwork of Spanish Revival soul, reimagined from the ground up. This custom-crafted residence offers a warm, rich, and inviting aesthetic that perfectly balances architectural integrity with inspired, modern design. Its rare geographical position provides sweeping, unobstructed views spanning from the iconic Hollywood Sign and Griffith Observatory to the glittering skyline of Downtown LA and the Pacific Ocean beyond. This vantage point creates an ethereal atmosphere, offering the distinct feeling of living gracefully above the city rather than within it. Upon arrival, guests are welcomed into an open-concept main floor where natural light cascades through the space, illuminating every corner. The heart of the home is a show-stopping chef's kitchen, anchored by a La Cornue range and appointed with custom oak cabinetry, Calacatta Rhino marble, Waterworks brass fixtures, and built-in Miele appliances. The living spaces flow seamlessly, from a cozy sitting room with an original brick fireplace to a formal dining room and a delightful sunroom. This glass-walled lounge offers panoramic vistas and direct access to an expansive outdoor observation deck, a shimmering pool, and a versatile bonus structure perfectly suited for a home office, private gym, or sophisticated guest suite. The upper level serves as a sanctuary in the clouds, where expansive windows and skylights invite the ever-changing California light into every corner. The primary suite is a cinematic retreat, featuring a one-of-a-kind view and a spa-inspired en-suite bath with custom cabinetry, a large soaking tub, and artisanal Arto Brick & Tile. An additional upstairs guest bedroom mirrors this refined style, offering its own private balcony and en-suite finishes. Encompassing some of the most coveted views in Los Angeles including the Hollywood Hills and Catalina Island - 6911 Los Tilos stands as a rare landmark of privacy and prestige in a world-class location.

results.remarks: Set in a coveted Silver Lake location, this 2019 architectural home unfolds across three light-filled levels. The main level brings everyone together: living, dining and kitchen spaces flow easily from one to the next. The kitchen features Bosch appliances and a generous peninsula that is easy for entertaining guests while you cook or a quick breakfast. An accordion glass door opens off the kitchen to a private terrace hedged to make it feel secluded and lush. The three bedrooms downstairs, each with its own en-suite bath, offer separation and privacy. The primary suite is especially serene, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-like bath. Dual vanities and an oversized shower complete the retreat. Continue upward to the expansive and private roof deck. By day, the views stretch across the hills and surrounding treetops. By evening, the landscape begins to twinkle. results.remarks: Set beneath mature Chinese elm trees in a quiet Eagle Rock enclave, this fully renovated mid-century home offers generous, light-filled living spaces, sweeping views, a flexible layout, and a detached bonus room ideal for a home office, gym, studio, or creative space. The main level opens to a bright, expansive living room, where warm wood floors and oversized windows create an airy, welcoming feel. The adjoining kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, dark stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant natural light, and a breakfast bar for casual dining. The dining room opens to a generous elevated deck framed by treetop and hillside views, extending the living space outdoors for dining, lounging, and entertaining. Also on this level, the primary bedroom offers a spacious private retreat with an en-suite bathroom featuring a dual-sink vanity and glass-enclosed shower. Downstairs, two additional bedrooms and two bathrooms provide separation and privacy, while a substantial bonus living space adds another layer of versatility. Complete with a wet bar and multiple doors opening directly outdoors, the space is well suited for a media room, den, playroom, or casual gathering area. The detached bonus room further expands the home's versatility, creating a dedicated space for work, wellness, hobbies, or creative pursuits. Just moments from Eagle Rock's neighborhood restaurants, cafes, shops, and everyday conveniences, and located within the coveted Dahlia Heights Elementary school district, the home pairs its generous and flexible living spaces with an equally desirable neighborhood setting.

results.remarks: Beneath a glorious, century-old sycamore tree on Bowling Green Way north of Sunset, lies a meticulously redesigned Tudor, waiting to transport you to the English countryside. This Brentwood jewel-box features the finest materials and craftsmanship, and will delight your senses while offering thoughtful modern conveniences which you will certainly appreciate. Patterns, colors and textures embellish this revived home with warmth and character, and secret doors that open to reveal hidden surprises throughout. Enter through the impressive vintage door, and step onto wide plank herringbone wood floors with inlaid brass-details, taking in the bold colors and exciting sight-lines. Move towards the huge bright kitchen, with a La Cornue stove, Thermador and Sub Zero appliances, Antolini Cristallo quartzite counters, a beautiful Devol kitchen sink, abundant custom cabinetry and a hidden scullery. Cooking and entertaining in this space will certainly be an exceptional pleasure. Host grand meals in the oversized formal dining room with original ceiling beams, built-in cabinets for serving and a decorative fireplace. The living room has wonderful natural light, high ceilings, and gorgeous House of Hackney wallpaper. The primary suite will take you on a journey through European charm and luxury, with loads of closets and thoughtful details, plus an elegant bathroom with a clawfoot tub you will never want to leave. Two additional bedrooms plus an office give you plenty of space for family, guests and work. Alternatively, give your guests their own space in the 2 story detached ADU, with a decorative fireplace and bathroom on each level. The upstairs feels like a treehouse perch, with beamed ceilings, diamond pane windows, Zia tiled bathroom and a dutch door, and the lower level opens to the pool and functions as a wonderful lounging and entertaining space. The brand new pool and spa feature bluestone coping, and are surrounded by grass and DG, and flanked by a fabulous outdoor kitchen. Enjoy quiet moments in this serene garden, or invite your friends over for lively parties. This very special house is sure to bring you a lifetime of joy.

results.remarks: Where Franklin Hills, Los Feliz and Silver Lake converge, 3836 De Longpre Ave offers a true urban oasis and Zen-like home with modern, multi-level living. A gated entrance opens onto expansive grounds sheltered by a canopy of mature trees and artfully landscaped with agave, cacti and meandering pathways. As you descend down the Saltillo and Talavara tile staircase, you feel the immediate tranquil calm of this city retreat. Enter the home and you're immediately immersed in welcoming, northern light. There are captivating moments at every turn: a bay window framing the dramatic, drought-tolerant hillside garden, soaring ceilings that impart a sense of expansiveness, and organic flagstone flooring cool to the touch of your bare feet. The open floor plan seamlessly combines the living, dining and kitchen spaces. The connecting bedroom lets the southern light in bringing more garden views and a full ensuite bath finished with terracotta tile, clawfoot tub and a Mexican hand-painted Talavera-tile mural. In keeping with the earthy, natural materials, the kitchen offers concrete counters and a view onto a majestic Monterey Pine. The stairwell to the upper floor provides dramatic light-play throughout the day and the accent windows provide snapshots of the sculpted landscape as you ascend to the family room. With sliding doors that open to a wraparound balcony, this level is flooded with natural light. Airy and floating amongst the treetops, there is ample room for comfortable living, working, and entertaining. The high walls provide the perfect place to contemplate your art collection salon-style or you can take in the neighborhood hillside views. Just beyond, the primary suite is complete with an ensuite bath that continues the spa-retreat tranquility of the home with a large soaking tub, walk-in shower and a skylight. A spiral staircase descends past glass block walls to the second guest bedroom that opens directly onto the back patio, plus a showstopping 3/4 bath with a walk-in shower clad in floor-to-ceiling natural flagstone. The laundry room completes this level, ideal for guest quarters or a work-from-home flex space. Ideally located just minutes from Sunset Junction, this home is also close to neighborhood favorites like Lyric Hyperion Theater & Cafe and the Silver Lake Reservoir. 3836 De Longpre Ave is a rare opportunity to enjoy a retreat-like, private oasis within the community of one of the Eastside's most beloved pockets.

results.remarks: Tucked into the canyon and surrounded by a peaceful sense of privacy, this charming villa is a home defined by light, warmth, and an effortless connection to its natural surroundings. Throughout the day, shafts of sunlight filter through tall French doors and windows, illuminating warm wood floors and creating an atmosphere that feels both inspiring and wonderfully serene. The main-level entry creates an immediate sense of arrival and connection, flowing naturally between the home's three principal spaces: the gourmet kitchen, formal dining room, and spacious, elegant living room. The sun-filled living room is particularly captivating, with beamed ceilings, warm wood floors, a fireplace, and tall French doors and windows that draw in beautiful canyon light and give the room a timeless, European quality. Just off the living room, a cozy den connects seamlessly to the space, creating an intimate TV and media room perfect for movie nights, casual evenings, or simply curling up and relaxing. The formal dining room provides an inviting setting for dinners and entertaining, while the beautifully appointed gourmet kitchen combines modern functionality with the warmth and character of the villa. Stone countertops, custom cabinetry, Saltillo tile floors, beamed ceilings, a Miele cooktop and oven, and built-in refrigerator create a kitchen designed for both serious cooking and everyday living. Together, these spaces form a wonderfully connected main level equally suited to intimate evenings at home or entertaining family and friends. A versatile ground-level studio/bedroom with its own bathroom is currently used as a private hair studio, but offers tremendous flexibility as a home office, gym, creative studio, or additional private space. Upstairs, all three bedrooms are thoughtfully located together on one level, creating an especially desirable floor plan for family living while offering wonderful flexibility. The generous bright primary suite feels like a private sanctuary, with its own fireplace bringing warmth and romance to the bedroom. The adjoining spa-inspired bath is illuminated by natural light from a skylight and features two separate vanities, an oversized soaking tub, separate shower, custom shoe closet, and walk-in closet a peaceful retreat in which to begin and end the day. Two additional guest bedroom suites complete the upper level, providing an ideal arrangement for guests, a nursery, or home office. The layout strikes a wonderful balance connected for family life while allowing each bedroom its own sense of privacy and retreat. A powder room, laundry room, two direct-access parking spaces, and a charming rear brick patio terrace complete the home. The terrace extends the living experience outdoors a peaceful setting for morning coffee, intimate dinners, or evenings beneath the canyon sky. More than simply a collection of rooms, this is a home with a feeling: peaceful, soulful, inviting, and filled with beautiful natural light. French doors open, shafts of sunlight stream in, fireplaces glow, and the canyon becomes part of everyday life. It captures the relaxed romance and charm of a European villa with the comfort, functionality, and flexibility of a home designed and built brand new in 2000 and meant to truly be lived in.

results.remarks: Set into the hillside, just steps from York & Fig, this Highland Park find is a love letter to indoor-outdoor living. Golden-hour views spill across a private hillside perch, tucked away from prying eyes, where the land opens onto a flat, sprawling pad made for long afternoons: a new saltwater pool, kept crystal and gentle on the skin by a Hayward salt chlorine generator and UV/Ozone sanitizer that dramatically cuts the need for chlorine, for cooling off, a spot for dining al fresco, and open lawn for gardening, play, or simply catching your breath. Fruit trees dot the property, offering oranges, lemons and mandarins. Fully enclosed and gated, it's your own quiet compound, shielded from the neighbors' view, complete with room to park, room to shoot hoops, and room to grow things. Inside, the heart of the home holds a surprise: a long-ago garage conversion that's become the soul of the house, a light-filled living area with its own bath and laundry hookups, woven seamlessly into the home's footprint and taped square footage, with comfort quietly handled by a 2024 AC replacement and a whole-house water softening system, so the everyday runs as smoothly as the setting suggests. Not an afterthought, but where life actually happens. A fantastic pocket of Highland Park where the setting does half the talking.

results.remarks: Fully reimagined Organic Modern home offering a vast 2,206 square feet (per appraiser). 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and two separate suites on a quiet Del Rey street just 4 miles from the sand.                                         Inside, warmth meets elevated, editorial finish. A tall, proud custom oak door opens to vaulted ceilings and skylights that pour light through the living spaces. The designer staged it with sophistication and a whimsical flow. An arched doorway framing the view, glimpses of the kitchen beyond, a delicate wine cellar tucked under the stairs, and a subtle glass banister chosen to add depth without interrupting the sightlines. A softened plaster fireplace anchors the living room. A second warms the dining room. Luxury vinyl plank and new double pane windows throughout.                                         Off the living room, a laundry room with washer and dryer included (hold that thought), then the designer's own Hollywood powder room. Dimensional palm leaf wallpaper, a scalloped brass mirror, and a wall mounted brass faucet over a vessel sink.                                         Down the hall, a vaulted garden suite, currently staged as an office, unfolds with real privacy. A large closet, an evergreen tile and glass shower, and sliding doors opening straight to the backyard.Past the white tiled wine cellar, the entertainment kitchen. This is where the home really shines. Quartz waterfall counters, a hand plastered custom hood, and brass pendants over an island built for lingering. FORNO appliances with an eight burner range, and custom pantries built to actually hold something. A large window opens directly to the backyard bar, so guests can be served from the kitchen without anyone leaving the party. The adjacent slider keeps food, drinks, and people moving freely between inside and out. But it's the backyard where this home comes alive. Over 9 feet of privacy fencing for intimate garden moments, soft grass to play on or lay in, and string lights for evenings that run long. A custom swing, the designer's own flourish and the detail everyone remembers, anchors a space with a fire feature, bar seating, pavers and gravel. A retreat from the city that happens to be in it.Upstairs, the primary suite unfolds down its own hallway beneath a cloud like glass chandelier, with French doors to a private balcony framed by tree canopy and the Del Rey cityscape beyond. Morning coffee, evening drink, same view. The primary bath is the spa the designer had in mind. Zellige backsplash across a double vanity, marble foot ledge, soaking tub, his and hers shower heads, a custom solid wood vanity, warm brass fixtures, and two windows worth of daylight. Built for spending the whole day in, and she meant it. Down a separate corridor, two more bedrooms in that same oak character plank, each with a ceiling fan, new windows, and views of trees and greenery. The Jack and Jill between them brings fog green cabinets, champagne brass knobs, custom quartz vanities, and porcelain tile. Closets everywhere. And that second laundry, so there is no need to carry anything downstairs.An attached 2 car garage and a generous driveway handle daily life and guest overflow with room to spare.                                        The neighborhood delivers, too. The Ballona Creek Bike Path starts around the corner and runs to the ocean, with Bluff Creek Dog Park 1.5 miles away. Venice, Marina del Rey, and Playa del Rey beaches sit within 4.5 miles, and the UCLA Marina Aquatic Center offers sailing, kayaking, and paddleboarding to the public year round. Closer to home, coffee at Mad Lab and pastries from Angel Maid, both under 1 mile, with burgers at Mom's List at 1.7 miles, Runway Playa Vista's shops 1.8 miles across the creek, and the Loyola Marymount campus 2.5 miles up the bluff.Warm, textured, a little unexpected, and endlessly livable. A home built for the way families actually want to live. 4 miles to the sand, roughly 14 to DTLA.

This is Brentwood at its most extraordinary - a luminous trophy that lives as beautifully as it photographs.

All of this is just moments away from Westwood Village, The Geffen Playhouse, and Warner Avenue Elementary, this home blends classic elegance with modern functionality, perfectly suited for indoor-outdoor California living.

results.remarks: Rare architectural gem by award-winning Michael W. Folonis, AIA. This dramatic, newly remodeled tri-level townhome offers a rare combination of architectural pedigree, expansive outdoor space, and incredible Westside views. Featuring 3 potential bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, including a versatile loft that can easily function as a third bedroom, office, or creative workspace, this home delivers the ultimate live/work loft experience. Soaring ceilings and an abundance of natural light create an impressive sense of volume throughout the main living level. The completely remodeled interior features new wood floors in a sophisticated, flat natural finish, along with a stunning custom chef's kitchen showcasing a center island, custom cabinetry, white quartz countertops, and Bosch and Samsung appliances. The spacious living and dining area features soaring ceilings and opens seamlessly to the kitchen and private balcony, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the generous loft provides exceptional flexibility and opens to another private outdoor patio. Continue to the expansive private rooftop deck, where panoramic views stretch across the Westside to the Santa Monica Mountains, Getty Center, and Hollywood Sign. Enjoy spectacular sunsets from one of the home's multiple outdoor spaces or entertain guests on the impressive rooftop deck. The lower level features two well-sized bedrooms, each with beautifully updated, spa-like en-suite bathrooms. Additional features include central air and heat, in-unit laundry, two secured parking spaces, and a secured garage. Set within a quiet, well-maintained complex and conveniently located near shops, restaurants, and all that the Westside has to offer, this is a truly special home that combines architectural pedigree, modern luxury, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living. This is the one you've been waiting forand it won't last long.

results.remarks: Welcome to a residence where timeless European elegance meets contemporary refinement, set within Le Parc, one of Century City's most coveted full-service, guard-gated communities. This extensively upgraded and elegantly remodeled 2-bedroom, Den, 4-bath home has been designer-decorated and meticulously curated down to the last detail. The arrival experience sets the tone immediately. A dramatic black-and-white marbled entry evokes classic Continental sophistication before opening into interiors defined by soaring ten-foot ceilings, striking white oak chevron floors, and custom solid wood doors that lend genuine architectural warmth and richness throughout. Large-scale double-paned windows flood the open floor plan with natural light while preserving an exceptional sense of quiet, and a marble fireplace anchors the gracious living area, equally suited to entertaining and everyday comfort. At the heart of the home, a gourmet Viking kitchen pairs premium appliances with generous cabinetry and a thoughtfully designed layout built for effortless flow. Two expansive bedroom suites deliver true privacy and luxury, each with a walk-in closet and beautifully finished bath, while additional baths welcome guests with ease. LED lighting reinforces the clean, modern aesthetic, and abundant built-in storage, plus dedicated extra storage, offers a rare measure of everyday practicality. Two private balconies overlook lush greenery, creating a serene indoor-outdoor connection in the middle of the city. Le Parc residents enjoy 24-hour guard-gated security, concierge service, pools, tennis courts, fitness facilities, and manicured European-inspired grounds, all just moments from Century City's world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment. Turnkey, designer-quality, and quietly sophisticated, this is elevated luxury living at its most refined.
