results.remarks: Welcome to this gated contemporary gem, tucked away on a desirable Bel Air street with fantastic views of twinkling city lights. Numerous walls of glass and picture windows throughout welcome natural light within this spacious floor plan. A stone fireplace commands the living room, with its wood floors and towering vaulted ceilings. In the kitchen, discover Viking appliances, copious cabinetry, an eat-in breakfast area, and an oversized center island with cooktop, commercial-size hood, prep sink, and serving ledge. Entertain family and friends in the formal dining room, complete with wide-plank flooring and set amidst a striking backdrop of the cityscape beyond. The family room includes a large wet bar for serving guests, built-in book cases, and a raised sunny viewing area that looks out to the sparkling pool. The primary bedroom opens to the outside via sliding glass and has an en-suite bath with jetted tub, separate shower, and dual-sink vanity. Other bedrooms and bathrooms are well-appointed and light-filled. A bonus room, currently imagined as an office, can be a gym or yoga studio and opens to a sun deck. There is also a dry sauna for maximizing wellness! In the backyard, dine al-fresco on sprawling patios, tend to the vegetable gardens, and enjoy incredible views of the city. Note: In addition to being offered for sale, the seller is open to exploring a joint venture partnership to develop a new project or remodel the existing property. Interested parties are welcome to inquire about joint-venture opportunities.

results.remarks: Clean lines. Soaring ceilings. Warm European oak floors. Designer finishes at every turn. This is Contemporary Mediterranean living at its finest. Wrapped in smooth Santa Barbara stucco and complemented by thoughtfully designed drought-tolerant landscaping, the indoor and outdoor spaces blend seamlessly to create the effortless California lifestyle you've been searching for. Ideally located just minutes from USC, Exposition Park, BMO Stadium, the Metro Rail, Downtown Los Angeles, Kenneth Hahn State Recreation Area, popular restaurants, coffee shops, and convenient Westside access, this home delivers luxury, location, and lifestyle in one exceptional package. Luxury. Design. Location. Opportunities like this don't come along often. Discover why 3763 S. Gramercy Place is one of Jefferson Park's most exceptional offerings. Schedule your private tour today.

results.remarks: Welcome to 10572 Putney Road, Los Angeles, CA.5 Bedroom/ 4 Bath (1 Bedroom Detached Guest House)3,408 s.f. Living Area7,005 s.f. Lot AreaA modern 5 bedroom, 4 bath home with a detached 1 bedroom/1 bath Guest House is a one of a kind in the heart of Cheviot Hills. Designed and built in 2024 with an emphasis on modern design, function, and structure.Approaching the home sitting tall above the sidewalk, the extra wide driveway provides comfortable access. The Drought Tolerant Landscaping with a drip irrigation system saves labor and water. All surrounded by a new Pour-in Place Concrete Retaining Walls and Stairs with added reinforcements.Through the Modern Glass Entry Door, the Main Entry space features a spacious 16' high ceiling/skylights and a warm stone accent wall for welcoming guests. The Main Bedroom also has a 12' high ceiling/skylights, with warm, modern wood slat accents to balance the modern high scale space. The Main Suite features a walk-in closet with a modern warm custom cabinetry. The Main Bathroom is spacious with a long counter space, large Glass Enclosed Walk-in Shower, and a Free Standing Modern Tub. The corner front Bedroom 1/Office, has a 10' ceiling/skylight for a bright, spacious, and open feel. The Jack & Jill bathroom with a bathtub is accessible from both Bedroom 2, and Bedroom 3, for practicality. The Powder Room features a large glass Walk-in Shower for guests. Throughout the house, high quality, modern Hansgrohe, Toto, GE Monogram fixtures, and accents are featured. Moving to the rear, the highlight of the home is the Great Room that opens out to the Rear Patio  through 16' glass sliders.  Again, a 12' high ceiling/skylights makes it an ideal space for gathering and entertainment.  The Kitchen features Monogram Appliances, Custom modern Cabinets, matching Modern Stone Counter Tops, Modern Glass Back-lit LED Backsplash. Directly connected Rear Patio with a full Outdoor Cooking Station provides functional, shade in the afternoon for outdoor sitting, dining, and entertaining.Connected to the Rear Patio, is a new separate 1 Bedroom Guest House. It features the same open space design with a Modern, large Living, Dining, and Kitchen. Separate Bedroom, and a separate Bath with a large glass walk-in shower and a space for full size stackable Washer and Dryer. The Guest House is anchored by a grass Play/Sitting area with a beautiful matured Oak Tree, and native California landscapingAdditional home features include, paid Solar Panels, 4 Outdoor Gas Tankless Water Heaters, strategically located to provide instant hot water, Rainwater Irrigation system, Water Softener, 400 Amp Main Electrical Service, New plumbing, New electrical, New HVAC, EV Charging Circuits/Junction boxes in the garage, future Driveway Gate Motor Circuit, and Conduit/Junction box, ADT security, and Ring camera system to name a few.The home is located in one of the most desirable, historical areas in West Los Angeles, Cheviot Hills.  The location provides 15-25* cooler temperatures in the summer with its proximity to the near by Santa Monica Ocean, Easy access to 2 major freeways, short walking distance to a Blue Ribbon Primary School, walking distance to historical Rancho Park Public Golf Course, close to UCLA, walking distance to the future UCLA Westside Pavillion Medical Research Campus, Century City Mall, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica Beach,  Fox and Sony Studios.The spacious modern home provides a great opportunity to enjoy life in one of the L.A's best areas on the Westside. Some photos have been virtually rendered.

results.remarks: There are homes that simply offer a place to live, and then there are homes that change the way you feel the moment you arrive. Situated within one of the Hollywood Hills' most enchanting enclaves, this private retreat is a rare balance of architecture, nature, and effortless California living. Inspired by the clean lines and warmth of mid-century design while embracing a distinctly modern soul, the residence unfolds through a series of thoughtfully connected spaces that invite both gathering and solitude. Natural light pours through expansive windows, illuminating warm wood floors, curated finishes, and intimate moments throughout the home where creativity seems to flourish. Inside, the open living, dining, and kitchen spaces flow seamlessly together before spilling outdoors, capturing the essence of Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle. A bedroom and full bath on each level offer exceptional flexibility and privacy, equally suited for guests, work-from-home living, or simply embracing the home's thoughtful layout. Multiple terraces and garden escapes extend the living experience beyond the walls, creating an effortless dialogue between architecture and nature. Morning coffee among the trees. Dinner beneath glowing cafe lights. A quiet afternoon with a book as the breeze moves through the leaves. Crowning it all is an extraordinary private rooftop retreat: an experience unto itself. Here, sweeping views stretch across the Hollywood Hills toward the glittering city skyline, transforming every sunset into a daily ritual and every evening into an unforgettable backdrop for entertaining or quiet reflection beneath the stars.  What makes this property truly exceptional isn't any one feature -- it's the feeling it creates. The rare ability to spend the morning hiking canyon trails, enjoy lunch on the Sunset Strip, entertain friends on your rooftop as the city begins to glow, and end the evening in complete tranquility surrounded by nature. This is the Hollywood Hills at its most authentic: private, creative, timeless, and undeniably inspiring.

results.remarks: Tucked into the coveted Kirkwood Bowl pocket of Laurel Canyon, this beautifully reimagined 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence captures the essence ofCalifornia living at its best. Set on a corner lot, the approximately 1,596-square-foot home has been recently renovated down to the studs, blending warm modern design with thoughtful, elevated finishes throughout. Natural wood siding, a sleek metal roof, and drought-tolerant landscaping create a striking first impression, while skylights and abundant windows fill the interiors with natural light and frame serene canyon views. Designed with entertaining in mind, the open-concept main living space seamlessly connects the living room and kitchen, where collapsible doors dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. The chef's kitchen features a sleek contemporary aesthetic with stainless steel appliances, an eat-in center island, and clean, modern lines, all set beneath soaring vaulted, wood-beamed ceilings. Built-in outdoor speakers enhance the experience, making the transition to al fresco living effortless and inviting. The spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat, offering tranquil canyon vistas and a sense of calm. Outdoors, curated spaces elevate the lifestyle offering with a sauna and cold plunge, perfect for relaxation and wellness. Additional features include a detached garage and central A/C and heat. Ideally located just moments from the Canyon Country Mart and within the highly regarded Wonderland Elementary School District, this is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey retreat in one ofLaurel Canyon's most desirable enclaves.

results.remarks: With defining architectural elements and a profound connection to its landscape, this recently transformed mid-century residence unfolds as a series of light-filled spaces where every room feels beautifully curated. Enveloped by gardens conceived by Garrett Carlson and Mark Levine, the property offers a rare sense of calm, with mature greenery, sculptural plantings, and carefully framed sight lines creating an atmosphere that feels worlds away from the city beyond.Venetian plaster introduces a warm, tactile palette that continues throughout, while expansive walls of glass dissolve traditional boundaries, allowing the surrounding gardens to become an integral part of the architecture. The principal living room is centered around a sculptural bronze mirrored fireplace, its generous scale extending effortlessly outdoors through disappearing glass. The entertaining spaces transition naturally from one to the next. The kitchen is appointed with custom cabinetry, stone surfaces, a Wolf range, and a complete suite of Miele appliances. An integrated display for glassware and a bespoke bar create a natural focal point before opening to a more relaxed family living area. Nearby, a dedicated wine lounge with its own full bath and thoughtfully positioned laundry room reinforce the home's functionality. Privately positioned, the primary suite continues the home's dialogue with nature, opening directly onto the gardens through walls of glass. A dramatic two-level dressing room offers boutique-like proportions, while the bath introduces richly veined Italian onyx vanities, a rainfall shower, and a palette selected to evoke the atmosphere of a private wellness retreat. A spacious secondary suite and an adaptable third room provide flexibility for guests, an office, fitness studio, or creative space depending on lifestyle. Outside, the grounds are thoughtfully arranged around a pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, dining terrace, and fire lounge, all surrounded by layered landscaping that creates exceptional privacy. Completed between 2020 and 2023, the home's extensive renovation reached well beyond aesthetics, incorporating upgraded mechanical systems, new HVAC, and solar infrastructure to complement its architectural transformation. The result is a residence where timeless mid-century principles have been thoughtfully reinterpreted through contemporary craftsmanship, creating a home that feels enduring, highly livable, and quietly exceptional.

results.remarks: There's a moment when you walk into this Silver Lake home and realize the city isn't simply outside your window  it's part of the house.Morning begins with sunlight stretching across the Silver Lake hills. Downtown Los Angeles sits in the distance, framed through walls of glass. As the day moves, the view changes with it, eventually giving way to glowing sunsets and a skyline filled with city lights.And now, this home has another chance to find its person.Through no fault of the seller, this fully reimagined Silver Lake Skyline Retreat is once again available  this time with its newly completed backyard and the final piece of the vision in place.The home was designed around its setting. Natural light pours inside, warm contemporary materials soften the spaces, and nearly every room finds a way to bring your eyes back toward the skyline. Open the doors and life naturally moves outside.The newly completed backyard feels like the ending this renovation was always waiting for. Dinner outside with friends. A quiet morning with coffee. Music playing while the sun goes down. A late night under the lights with Los Angeles glowing behind you. It's a space that doesn't compete with the view  it lets you live in it.Inside, the same attention was given to how the home feels as to how it looks. This was never intended to be a quick cosmetic flip. It was comprehensively renovated with craftsmanship, carefully selected materials and an attention to detail meant to last well beyond the first impression.The seller believes in that work enough to include a one-year workmanship warranty, something rarely offered with a resale home and an added layer of confidence for its next owner.Then there's Silver Lake itself.The Reservoir, neighborhood cafs, restaurants, boutiques and some of Los Angeles' most loved local spots are just moments away. You can spend the day immersed in the neighborhood and come home to a place that feels completely removed from the city below.Some homes give you a beautiful place to live.This one gives you a front-row seat to Los Angeles  from the first light of morning to the last lights of the city at night.The backyard is finished. The renovation is complete. The view was always here.Now, the next chapter is ready to begin.

results.remarks: New Price, Motivated Seller. Set behind private gates in the prestigious hills of Bel Air, this striking architectural estate delivers an extraordinary level of privacy, security, and presence offering a true sanctuary above the city. A secluded circular driveway accommodates up to seven vehicles, complemented by a spacious three-car garage, setting the tone for a residence defined by both discretion and effortless luxury. A dramatic arrival opens to luminous interiors where soaring ceilings and expansive walls of glass create a seamless, open-concept design tailored for modern living and grand-scale entertaining. Natural light floods the home through skylights and floor-to-ceiling windows, framing sweeping panoramic views of the city skyline, surrounding hills, and the Pacific Ocean. The main living spaces unfold with ease, centered around a stunning double-sided fireplace and living space that is enhanced by retractable glass walls that dissolve the boundary between indoors and out. A sleek bar anchors the living area, elevating the space into an entertainer's showpiece. A refined palette of cool stone and metallic finishes is perfectly balanced by the warmth of French white oak floors. Statement walls clad in Absolute Black Granite add depth and sophistication throughout. The chef's kitchen is both a visual centerpiece and a functional masterpiece, featuring an oversized island, bespoke cabinetry, natural stone surfaces, and  appliances all positioned to capture the home's breathtaking views and embodying the ultimate California indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The residence offers seven bedrooms and ten bathrooms, along with a private home theater, a 300-bottle wine cellar, and thoughtfully integrated bar spaces. Each room is curated to reflect a harmonious blend of comfort, scale, and architectural significance. A private elevator services all levels. Designed for unforgettable entertaining, the backyard rivals a luxury resort. An expansive outdoor living area with an kitchen flows effortlessly to a sophisticated bar setting near the spa perfect for hosting under the stars. The negative-edge infinity pool, sun deck, and spa overlook unobstructed vistas that stretch from the Los Angeles cityscape to the Pacific Ocean, creating a truly breathtaking backdrop. Just minutes from Beverly Hills, Westwood Village, and Brentwood, this exceptional offering represents a rare opportunity to own a statement residence that seamlessly blends bold design, ultimate privacy, and world-class views in one of Los Angeles' most coveted enclaves.

results.remarks: Set on an elevated, expansive lot, this modern estate offers more than 4,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Just moments from highly regarded Roscomare Elementary School and the Glen Centre where you'll find local favorite Jayde's market. Via Verona presents a rare combination of scale, refined design, and turnkey luxury in one of Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods.
